recipe.variant: Qwen-Image fp8 + InstantX ControlNet-Union (canny, soft edge, depth, pose) via ControlNetApplyAdvanced with VAE, 20 steps, cfg 2.5 - no LoRA
recipe.from_template: image_qwen_image_instantx_controlnet (subgraph 'ControlNet (Qwen-Image InstantX Union)' flattened). The template ships WITH the 4-step LoRA at 4 / 1.0; this recipe is the note table's 'fp8_e4m3fn 20 / 2.5' row without the LoRA. The 'Image to Depth Map (Lotus)' preprocessing subgraph is a separate stage (needs lotus-depth-d-v1-1 + vae-ft-mse) and is not part of this recipe

negative.note: official default is a single space " "; ignored at cfg 1

shift.note: 3-3.1 in every template; 'Increase the shift if you get too many blurry/dark/bad images. Decrease if you want to try increasing detail.'

control_map.note: a ready canny / soft-edge / depth / pose map (the template makes depth with a Lotus subgraph after FluxKontextImageScale); it is both the ControlNet image and, VAE-encoded, the output latent - so it sets the output size

recipe.defaults_note: 20 steps, cfg 2.5, shift 3.1, strength 1, 0-100%. Notes: 'Set cfg to 1.0 for a speed boost at the cost of consistency. Samplers like res_multistep work pretty well at cfg 1.0'; 'The official number of steps is 50 but I think that's too much. Even just 10 steps seems to work.' InstantX: add 'TEXT' to the prompt when there are text elements ('unable to preserve some details without explicit TEXT in prompt'). File goes in models/controlnet.
